entries.name: Next.js static export
entries.summary: React framework exported as static assets.
constraints: Server-only features cannot run in a static export
project_fit: Server rendering or dynamic server endpoints become necessary.
entries.operational_burden: Maintain dependencies and rebuild static assets.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: More build tooling than a small static site.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Server rendering or dynamic server endpoints become necessary.

entries.name: React with Vite
entries.summary: Client-rendered React application built with Vite.
constraints: Routing and data conventions need application choices
project_fit: Content discovery or server rendering becomes central.
entries.operational_burden: Maintain browser dependencies and build pipeline.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: Less framework guidance; client rendering needs care for SEO.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Content discovery or server rendering becomes central.

entries.name: Angular
entries.summary: Opinionated TypeScript application framework.
constraints: Larger conceptual surface for a small team
project_fit: A large team needs shared application conventions.
entries.operational_burden: Maintain framework upgrades and application conventions.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: More framework investment than a lightweight client.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: A large team needs shared application conventions.

entries.name: FastAPI
entries.summary: Python HTTP API with typed request validation.
constraints: Async code still requires careful blocking-I/O handling
project_fit: A built-in administrative back office becomes essential.
entries.operational_burden: Operate one API process and maintain Python dependencies.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: Background durability and admin UI are separate concerns.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: A built-in administrative back office becomes essential.

entries.name: Django
entries.summary: Python web framework with ORM and administrative tooling.
constraints: More integrated framework conventions
project_fit: Administrative workflows outweigh a minimal API surface.
entries.operational_burden: Maintain migrations, application server and framework updates.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: API schemas may require an additional library.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Administrative workflows outweigh a minimal API surface.

entries.name: NestJS
entries.summary: Structured TypeScript server framework.
strengths: Shared TypeScript skills and modular conventions
constraints: Decorator and dependency-injection learning curve
project_fit: The team standardizes on TypeScript end to end.
entries.operational_burden: Operate a Node service and maintain npm dependencies.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: More abstraction than a small HTTP service.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: The team standardizes on TypeScript end to end.

entries.name: PostgreSQL
entries.summary: Relational database with transactions, constraints and JSON support.
strengths: Strong transactional model and flexible querying
constraints: Scaling writes across regions requires additional design
project_fit: Measured regional write or availability requirements exceed a primary-based design.
entries.operational_burden: Use managed backups or operate backups, upgrades and recovery.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: A single primary is not transparent global write distribution.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Measured regional write or availability requirements exceed a primary-based design.

entries.name: MongoDB
entries.summary: Document database for aggregate-oriented records.
constraints: Flexible schemas do not remove validation or indexing work
project_fit: Record boundaries are document-centric with few cross-document joins.
entries.operational_burden: Manage indexes, backups and replica-set configuration or a managed tier.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: Cross-document relationships can complicate an otherwise relational domain.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Record boundaries are document-centric with few cross-document joins.

entries.name: CockroachDB
entries.summary: Distributed SQL database designed for resilient multi-node operation.
constraints: SQL compatibility and latency characteristics need workload tests
project_fit: Multi-region write availability is a demonstrated requirement.
entries.operational_burden: Plan cluster topology, capacity and recovery or pay for managed operation.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: Distribution adds latency and operational complexity; verify licensing.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Multi-region write availability is a demonstrated requirement.

entries.name: PostgreSQL-backed jobs
entries.summary: Durable job table using transactions and a worker in the existing deployment.
strengths: Avoids a separate broker for modest workloads
constraints: Requires safe claiming, retries, idempotency and retention
project_fit: Queue throughput or isolation needs exceed the application database.
entries.operational_burden: Operate a worker process and monitor job lag and table growth.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: Job load shares database capacity with application queries.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Queue throughput or isolation needs exceed the application database.

entries.name: Redis with RQ
entries.summary: Python background workers backed by Redis.
constraints: Durability depends on Redis persistence and deployment
project_fit: Python job throughput needs dedicated queue capacity.
entries.operational_burden: Operate Redis and workers; monitor failures and memory.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: Adds a service and persistence configuration; verify Redis licensing.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Python job throughput needs dedicated queue capacity.

entries.name: RabbitMQ
entries.summary: Message broker supporting acknowledgements and routing.
constraints: Broker topology and delivery semantics require expertise
project_fit: Multiple independent consumers need explicit routing and messaging semantics.
entries.operational_burden: Operate broker storage, queues, upgrades and consumers.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: More operational surface than a database-backed worker.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Multiple independent consumers need explicit routing and messaging semantics.

entries.name: Maintained session authentication
entries.summary: Use framework-maintained password/session facilities rather than bespoke cryptography.
strengths: Keeps simple authentication in the application
constraints: Application still owns recovery, session security and abuse controls
project_fit: SSO, federation or complex organization policies become necessary.
entries.operational_burden: Patch authentication libraries and test recovery and session expiry.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: Less turnkey enterprise federation than an identity platform.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: SSO, federation or complex organization policies become necessary.

entries.name: Keycloak
entries.summary: Self-hosted identity provider with federation protocols.
constraints: Requires identity-service availability and secure administration
project_fit: Enterprise federation is required and operators can own identity infrastructure.
entries.operational_burden: Operate identity database, upgrades, keys and recovery.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: Removes some application auth work but adds a critical service.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Enterprise federation is required and operators can own identity infrastructure.

entries.name: Auth0
entries.summary: Managed identity platform.
constraints: Plan limits and federation features require verification
project_fit: Enterprise federation is needed without self-hosting identity.
entries.operational_burden: Manage tenant configuration, callbacks, secrets and provider dependency.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: Vendor dependency and growing identity costs.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Enterprise federation is needed without self-hosting identity.

entries.name: Render Free single service
entries.summary: Managed single-service deployment suitable for a low-traffic demo.
constraints: Free web services sleep after inactivity; quotas and eligibility require verification
project_fit: Always-on availability, persistent workers or free-tier limits become requirements.
entries.operational_burden: Monitor cold starts, deployment health and free-instance-hour usage.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: Sleeping services are inappropriate for an always-on SLA; background workers may need a different plan.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Always-on availability, persistent workers or free-tier limits become requirements.

entries.name: Single virtual machine
entries.summary: Run the application on one provisioned host.
constraints: Host patching, backup and recovery are your responsibility
project_fit: Dedicated workers or host-level control are required.
entries.operational_burden: Maintain OS, TLS, reverse proxy, monitoring and recovery.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: Usually a recurring compute cost and a single-host failure domain.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Dedicated workers or host-level control are required.

entries.name: Kubernetes
entries.summary: Container orchestration for multi-service infrastructure.
constraints: Needs cluster expertise; not a default for small applications
project_fit: Large scale and a capable dedicated operations team justify orchestration.
entries.operational_burden: Operate cluster upgrades, ingress, security, networking and capacity.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: Significant complexity and infrastructure costs for a small service.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Large scale and a capable dedicated operations team justify orchestration.

entries.name: GitHub Actions
entries.summary: Repository-integrated automated checks and build workflows.
constraints: Runner minutes, artifact retention and permissions need controls
project_fit: Repository hosting or compliance constraints change.
entries.operational_burden: Maintain pinned actions, workflow permissions and runner budgets.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: Provider-specific workflows and usage quotas.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Repository hosting or compliance constraints change.

entries.name: GitLab CI/CD
entries.summary: Pipeline configuration integrated with GitLab.
constraints: Hosted runner quotas and migration costs need evaluation
project_fit: The organization standardizes on GitLab.
entries.operational_burden: Maintain pipelines and runner permissions or self-host runners.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: Moving an existing GitHub workflow adds migration work.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: The organization standardizes on GitLab.

entries.name: Jenkins
entries.summary: Self-hosted extensible automation server.
constraints: Controller and plugin security need active maintenance
project_fit: Build isolation or legacy integrations require a self-hosted controller.
entries.operational_burden: Patch controller/plugins, manage agents and backups.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: Operational ownership is substantial compared with hosted CI.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Build isolation or legacy integrations require a self-hosted controller.

entries.name: Grafana Cloud with OpenTelemetry
entries.summary: Managed telemetry backend accepting OpenTelemetry signals.
strengths: Avoids operating a telemetry storage stack
constraints: Ingestion and retention quotas require verification
project_fit: Telemetry volume or residency exceeds the managed offering.
entries.operational_burden: Set sampling, scrub sensitive data and monitor ingestion budgets.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: Quota limits and hosted-provider dependency.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Telemetry volume or residency exceeds the managed offering.

entries.name: Prometheus and Grafana
entries.summary: Self-hosted metrics collection and dashboards.
constraints: Logs and traces need additional components
project_fit: Data residency or local infrastructure favors self-hosted metrics.
entries.operational_burden: Operate storage, scraping, alert delivery and upgrades.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: Metrics alone are not full logs/metrics/traces observability.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Data residency or local infrastructure favors self-hosted metrics.

entries.name: OpenTelemetry Collector pipeline
entries.summary: Vendor-neutral telemetry processing and export gateway.
constraints: Collector is not a telemetry storage or dashboard backend
project_fit: Multiple services need centralized telemetry policy.
entries.operational_burden: Maintain receivers, processors, exporters and downstream storage.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: Adds a service and still needs a destination.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Multiple services need centralized telemetry policy.

entries.name: Email, SMS and calendar adapters
entries.summary: Small provider adapters for notifications and calendar export.
strengths: Matches booking reminders and guest notifications
constraints: SMS delivery and consent vary by region; email needs deliverability setup
project_fit: Delivery volume, geography or consent rules change.
entries.operational_burden: Manage consent, secrets, retries, delivery reports and provider quotas.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: Messaging can incur cost even on an otherwise free stack.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Delivery volume, geography or consent rules change.

entries.name: Hosted payment adapter
entries.summary: Use hosted checkout and verified payment webhooks.
strengths: Avoid handling raw card details in the application
constraints: Payment fees and supported regions require verification
project_fit: Payments or deposits become confirmed in-scope requirements.
entries.operational_burden: Verify signatures and implement idempotent reconciliation.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: Provider coupling and financial reconciliation complexity.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Payments or deposits become confirmed in-scope requirements.

entries.name: Generic HTTP/webhook adapters
entries.summary: Explicit adapters for third-party HTTP APIs.
strengths: Keeps provider boundaries visible and testable
constraints: Each provider has distinct retries and rate limits
project_fit: New integrations need capabilities beyond messaging or payments.
entries.operational_burden: Manage timeouts, signatures, secrets and failure recovery.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: More custom integration code than a provider-specific SDK.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: New integrations need capabilities beyond messaging or payments.

entries.name: Self-hosted open-weight model
entries.summary: Optional local inference infrastructure, not called by BuildWise.
strengths: Control over model hosting and data flow
constraints: Weights licenses, hardware capacity and evaluation require review
project_fit: Privacy requirements justify hosting and the team can operate inference.
entries.operational_burden: Operate inference capacity, model updates, evaluation and safety controls.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: No API bill does not mean no compute or maintenance cost.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Privacy requirements justify hosting and the team can operate inference.

entries.name: Hosted model API
entries.summary: Optional external model provider for a future product, not BuildWise generation.
constraints: Usage costs, privacy and nondeterministic outputs require evaluation
project_fit: An explicit AI feature has measurable quality and budget requirements.
entries.operational_burden: Set budgets, evaluate outputs and review provider data policy.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: Provider dependency and per-request costs; never enabled by a keyword mention.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: An explicit AI feature has measurable quality and budget requirements.

entries.name: Managed AI platform
entries.summary: Optional managed model deployment and governance platform.
constraints: Platform features and minimum charges require verification
project_fit: Multiple AI workloads need shared governance and deployment tooling.
entries.operational_burden: Manage permissions, model endpoints, evaluation and spend controls.
entries.cost_note: pricing/free-tier claims require verification; consult current provider terms, limits and regional availability.
trade_offs: More platform complexity and potential lock-in than one API.
assumptions: Validate this option against workload tests, team skills and current licensing.
change_conditions: Multiple AI workloads need shared governance and deployment tooling.
